title: A story's examples are history once the story ends
situation: Raised by the lead realizing intent-based delegation, 2026-10-15. A story is done only when its criteria hold in merged work, yet a dropped story's examples also stop standing.
decision: A story ends merged or dropped; it is done only when it ends merged with its acceptance criteria holding. Either way, once it ends its examples are history: they record what it was reviewed against and no longer state the design. The current design is the concepts; an example that should keep standing is kept by a decision naming it. Examples of integrated cuts stay history.
consequences: The record's views show a story's examples as history once it ends, merged or dropped.
